temperature_limit.description: Maximum allowed temperature for the cooling return flow.

limit_max_output_energy_to_avoid_pulsing.description: Limits the maximum output energy to avoid cases where the negotiated temperature alternates in every time step.

optim_temperature_abs_tol.description: Absolute tolerance for optimizing temperature mode.

optim_temperature_rel_tol.description: Relative tolerance for optimizing temperature mode.

temperature_mode.description: Mode of how the temperature is negotiated. Includes simple calculations and also a mode optimising for the maximum amount of energy exchanged.

use_hysteresis.description: If activated uses a hysteresis between two given temperatures.

profile_path.description: File path to the profile being used as limiting PLR.

control_mode.description: How the controlled component interacts with the monitored storage. Use 'charge' when the component fills the storage: it turns on below the lower threshold and off above the upper threshold. Use 'discharge' when the component consumes energy from the storage: it turns on above the upper threshold and off below the lower threshold.

high_threshold.description: Upper relative storage-level boundary. In 'charge' mode, the component turns off at or above this value. In 'discharge' mode, it turns on above this value.

low_threshold.description: Lower relative storage-level boundary. In 'charge' mode, the component turns on below this value. In 'discharge' mode, it turns off at or below this value.

min_run_time.description: Minimum time for which the component remains on after starting. The normal turn-off threshold is ignored until this time has passed. A full storage in 'charge' mode or an empty storage in 'discharge' mode still stops the component immediately. This value should ideally be a multiple of the simulation time step.

storage_uac.description: UAC of the storage component whose level controls this component.

input_order.description: Decides if the input temperatures are sorted by lowest or highest first.

input_temps.description: Decides if the minimum or maximum input temperature is used for sorting.

output_order.description: Decides if the output temperatures are sorted by lowest or highest first.

output_temps.description: Decides if the minimum or maximum output temperature is used for sorting.

efficiency_el_in.description: Efficiency function for the electricity input

efficiency_el_out.description: Efficiency function for the electricity output

linear_interface.description: Which interface is considered linear relative to the part-load-ratio

nr_discretization_steps.description: Number of intervals for interpolated efficiency functions

calculate_economy.description: If set to true, performs the calculation of economic results, requiring the input parameters for all components.

interest_rate.description: Interest rate for the calculation of annuities.

labour_costs_per_hour.description: Cost of labour for the operation of components.

labour_costs_price_change_rate_per_year.description: Rate of change of labour costs per year.

observation_period_in_years.description: The period in consideration for the calculation of economic results.

repeat_method.description: Defines which period of the result data is repeated to fill up the remainder of the observation period. This can be equal or less than the simulation period, for example simulating three years, but only repeating the last year for the entire observation period.

calculate_emissions.description: If set to true, performs the calculation of GHG emissions results, requiring the input parameters for all components.

include_embodied_emissions.description: If set to true, includes embodied emissions in the calculation.

observation_period_in_years.description: The period in consideration for the calculation of GHG emissions.

repeat_method.description: Defines which period of the result data is repeated to fill up the remainder of the observation period. This can be equal or less than the simulation period, for example simulating three years, but only repeating the last year for the entire observation period.

auxiliary_info.description: Toggle if auxiliary info about the current run should be written to markdown file

auxiliary_info_file.description: File path to where the auxiliary information will be written

auxiliary_plots.description: Toggle if additional plots of components, if they are available, are created

auxiliary_plots_formats.description: Multiple selection of which file formats are used to create the auxiliary plots. Allowed formats are: html, pdf, png, ps, svg

auxiliary_plots_path.description: Directory path to where the additional plots will be saved

base_path.description: If given, this path will be used as the base path for all relative paths used in the config file. If not given it defaults to the current working directory for the Julia process running ReSiE, which in almost all cases is the directory from which ReSiE is started.

csv_output.description: Sets the mode of the CSV output, switching between several default and custom behaviour modes as well an option of not creating a CSV file at all.

csv_output_file_path.description: File path to where the CSV output will be written

csv_output_keys.description: Specification for the CSV output in custom mode. See documentation for how this needs to be structured.

csv_output_weather.description: Toggle if the weather data read in from the given weather file should be included in the CSV output

csv_time_unit.description: Time unit for the timestamp of the CSV output

economic_csv_file_path.description: File path to where the economic results are written to CSV

economic_plot_cashflows_file_path.description: File path to where the economic cashflow plots are written

economic_plot_present_values_file_path.description: File path to where the economic present value plots are written
economic_plot_present_values_file_path.display_name: Economic present value plot file path

emissions_csv_file_path.description: File path to where the emissions are written to CSV

emissions_plot_file_path.description: File path to where the emissions plot file is written

fixed_output_precision.description: If given a non-zero value, uses this many significant digits as the fixed precision for float outputs in CSV and plot files. It is not recommended to use this setting in normal simulation. It's intended for making the output perfectly repeatable, which is useful for testing but changes the results.

output_economic_csv.description: Toggle if a CSV with the economic results should be created

output_emissions_csv.description: Toggle if a CSV with the emission results should be created

output_parameter_study_csv.description: Toggle if CSV file(s) with the parameter-study results should be created

output_parameter_study_plots.description: Toggle if plots with the parameter-study results should be created

output_plot.description: Sets the mode of the output plot, switching between several default and custom behaviour modes as well an option of not creating a plot file at all.

output_plot_file_path.description: File path to where the output line plot will be written

output_plot_spec.description: Specification for the output plot in custom mode. See documentation for how this needs to be structured.

output_plot_time_unit.description: Unit for x-axis of the output plot. Note that the plotted energies always refer to the simulation time step and not to the unit specified here!

parameter_study_csv_path.description: Directory path to where the parameter-study CSV result files are written to

parameter_study_plots_path.description: Directory path to where the parameter-study result plots will be written

plot_economic_cashflows.description: Toggle if the economic results (as cashflows) should be plotted

plot_economic_present_values.description: Toggle if the economic results (as present values) should be plotted

plot_emission_results.description: Toggle if the emission results should be plotted

plot_price_and_emission_profiles.description: Toggle if a plot with the utilized price and emission profiles should be created

plot_weather_data.description: Toggle if the weather data read in from the given weather file should be included in the line plot

price_and_emission_profile_file_path.description: File path to where the plot with price and emissions profiles should be written
price_and_emission_profile_file_path.display_name: Price and Emissions profiles plot file path

sankey_plot.description: Sets the mode of the sankey plot output, switching between default and custom behaviour as well an option of not creating a sankey plot file.

sankey_plot_file_path.description: File path to where the Sankey plot will be written

sankey_plot_spec.description: Specification for the sankey plot in custom mode. See documentation for how this needs to be structured.

show_detailed_errors.description: Toggle if errors should show a more detailed message. Only affects some errors.

step_info_interval.description: Defines how often a progress report on the loop over the timesteps of the simulation is logged to the info channel. This is useful to get an estimation of how much longer the simulation requires (albeit that such estimation is always inaccurate). If no value is given, automatically sets a value such that 20 reports are printed over the course of the simulation. To deactivate these reports, set this to 0.

write_csv_continuously.description: Toggle if CSV output will be written continuously, meaning in every time step. Activating this functionality will ensure partial output if the simulation fails during execution, however it also incurs a substantial performance penalty due to frequent file access.

write_parameter_study_csv_continuously.description: Toggle if parameter-study CSV output will be written continuously, meaning after every run. Activating this functionality will ensure partial output if the parameter study is stopped during execution. It incurs a slight performance penalty depending on the run time of one simulation and the number of parallel runs, since the threads might have to wait for write access.

write_summary_csv.description: Toggle if a CSV summary output with sum/mean values should be created additionally to the timestep-wise CSV output.

disable_all_simulation_outputs.description: Disables simulation outputs written to the hard drive during parameter studies.

objective_factors.description: Named coefficients for objective_function=`linear`. Every flattened objective parameter key must occur exactly once. Example: {"economic total_annuity": 1.0, "sum GridOut m_e_ac_230v IN": -2.0}.

objective_function.description: Defines how objective_params are combined. Supported values are `sum`, `linear` and `multi-objective`. For `linear`, coefficients must be supplied by objective_factors using the flattened objective parameter names as keys.

objective_params.description: Defines which parameters are set as the objective. Definition follows the definition of components. See the documentation for more details.

objective_senses.description: Defines whether each objective is minimised or maximised for objective_function=`multi-objective`. Keys must exactly match the flattened objective parameter names. Allowed values are `min` and `max`. If omitted, all objectives are minimised.

parameters.description: Defines the project parameters used by the parameter study. Each selected parameter can define bounds, an initial value, explicit or generated variation values and local-sensitivity values.

sensitivity_analysis.description: Configuration of global and local sensitivity analyses.

algorithm.description: Algorithm used by the selected optimisation backend.

f_tol_abs.description: Tolerance for changes or spread in the objective function. It is translated to the closest backend-specific stopping criterion; support depends on the selected algorithm.

max_runs.description: Maximum number of objective evaluations executed by the optimiser.

optim_kwargs.description: Additional keyword arguments passed to the selected optimisation backend.

refinement.description: Optional second optimisation stage starting from the best result of the primary optimisation. Its nested fields are exposed as refinement_optimisation by all_general_parameters().

run_optimisation.description: If set to true, runs the configured optimisation.

x_tol_abs.description: Tolerance for normalised optimisation parameters in the range [0, 1]. It is translated to the closest backend-specific stopping criterion, which may be absolute or relative; support depends on the selected algorithm.

bounds_max.description: Upper bound used by optimisation and global sensitivity.

bounds_min.description: Lower bound used by optimisation and global sensitivity.

range_length.description: Number of values in a generated parameter-variation range.

range_start.description: First value of a generated parameter-variation range.

range_step.description: Step size of a generated parameter-variation range.

range_stop.description: Last value of a generated parameter-variation range.

sensitivity_lower.description: Explicit lower evaluation value for local sensitivity.

sensitivity_upper.description: Explicit upper evaluation value for local sensitivity.

start.description: Initial optimisation value or standalone local-sensitivity reference.

values.description: Explicit discrete values used for parameter variation.

algorithm.description: Combination method for parameter values. Supported values are product, zip and random_*, where * is the number of samples.

run_parameter_variation.description: If set to true, executes the configured parameter variation.

algorithm.description: Algorithm used by the selected refinement optimisation backend.

f_tol_abs.description: Tolerance for changes or spread in the objective function. It is translated to the closest backend-specific stopping criterion; support depends on the selected algorithm.

max_runs.description: Maximum number of objective evaluations executed by the optimiser.

optim_kwargs.description: Additional keyword arguments passed to the selected refinement backend.

type.description: Optimisation backend used for the refinement stage.

x_tol_abs.description: Tolerance for normalised optimisation parameters in the range [0, 1]. It is translated to the closest backend-specific stopping criterion, which may be absolute or relative; support depends on the selected algorithm.

include_local_sensitivity_results_in_fig.description: If set to true, simulation results generated exclusively for local sensitivity analysis are additionally included in the general parameter-study result figures.
include_local_sensitivity_results_in_fig.display_name: Include local sensitivity results in figures?

local_reference.description: Reference point for local sensitivity. Use `start` for configured parameter start values or `best_result` for the best result so far from optimisation or global sensitivity analysis.

local_variation.description: Relative variation applied in positive and negative direction when no explicit sensitivity_lower and sensitivity_upper values are set.

max_runs.description: Maximum number of (additional) simulation performed for global sensitivity. If omitted, twice the optimisation max_runs value are used.

run_global_sensitivity.description: If set to true, calculates global sensitivity indices. Existing results from a parameter variation or optimisation are reused.

run_local_sensitivity.description: If set to true, calculates local sensitivity around configured start values or the best optimisation result.

end.description: End time (inclusive) of the simulation as datetime format. Will be rounded down to the nearest multiple of the time step.

epsilon.description: The absolute tolerance for many floating-point comparisons in the simulation. Two values whose difference falls below this threshold are treated as equal.

force_profiles_to_repeat.description: If set to true, all utilized profiles are allowed to be repeated, even if denied or not specified in the profile header! Attention: This parameter disables the profile parameter in the profile header!

latitude.description: The latitude of the location in WGS84. If given, it overwrites the coordinates read out of the weather file!

longitude.description: The longitude of the location in WGS84. If given, it overwrites the coordinates read out of the weather file!

start.description: Start time of the simulation as datetime format

start_end_unit.description: Datetime format specifier for parameters `start`, `start_output` and `end`

start_output.description: The start time as datetime format at which the simulation begins to output the simulation results. Has to be equal or later than `start`. Can be used to perform heat-up simulation ahead of the actual simulation. Note that during heat-up, no warnings are printed. The energies in the various output files are starting at the time specified in `start_output`.

time_step.description: Time step for the simulation. The parameter `time_step_unit` determines what the value in `time_step` means.

time_step_unit.description: Unit for the value given in parameter `time_step`.

time_zone.description: The time zone offset used in the current simulation in relation to UTC. If given, it overwrites the coordinates read out of the weather file! DWD-dat files are assumed to be in GMT+1.

weather_file_path.description: File path to the project-wide weather file. Can either be an EnergyPlus Weather File (EPW, time step has to be one hour, without leap day or DST) or a .dat file from the DWD (see https://kunden.dwd.de/obt/, free registration is required). See the component parameters on how to link weather file data to a component.

weather_interpolation_type_general.description: Interpolation type for weather data from weather file, except for solar radiation data. See the documentation for more details.

weather_interpolation_type_solar.description: Interpolation method for solar radiation data from weather file. See the documentation for more details.
